text:
These, son of noble family, are the two accomplishments of bodhisattva great beings.
“Son of noble family, there are two more accomplishments of bodhisattva great beings.
What are these two?
They are
the accomplishment of abandoning the faults of the levels
and the accomplishment of perfecting the skill of progressing from one level to the next.
Son of noble family, these are the two accomplishments of bodhisattva great beings.
“Son of noble family, there are two more accomplishments of bodhisattva great beings.
What are these two?
They are
the accomplishment of the hearers’ and
the practice of teaching the Dharma to one’s children,
and the practice of skill in not turning away from the enlightenment of buddhahood.
Noble son, these are the practices of bodhisattva great beings.
“Noble son, these are the practices of bodhisattva great beings.
Bodhisattva great beings should strive in these.
Noble son, bodhisattva great beings who practice in this way will not find it difficult to attain unsurpassed and perfect awakening.
Then the Blessed One said to the youthful Mañjuśrī,
